token_identity_source.progress_bar_location: The location token is a new locally owned InjectionToken; Material 16 legacy reexported its then-peer location token. These identities are distinct from the current peer location token.

limitations: Full diffs and identifier contexts support finite source roles. No runtime, compiled DI, motion, provider hierarchy, style, browser, producer, floor or G11 behavior is established.
